correctness.rationale: All twelve D4 roots are reconstructed from Euclidean simple roots by exact rational inversion. Direct comparability enumeration yields 17 facets and f=(12,24,12,1). Five listed free/coface pairs each have exactly one remaining coface, so elementary collapses preserve homotopy. The residue is exactly a suspension of a four-cycle (S^2), eight extra graph edges with three new vertices, and two isolated points. An explicit spanning tree leaves five unattached one-cells. The quotient by this contractible tree gives S^2 wedge five circles; mod-two boundary ranks (9,10,1) independently check the expected reduced homology ranks (2,5,1). The proof is integral and does not extrapolate from finite tests.

value.rationale: Type D4 is the first nonshellable Dynkin type-D root-poset antichain complex, so it is the canonical first boundary case in the new 2026 classification. Determining its entire homotopy type, including free fundamental group of rank five and an embedded octahedral two-sphere, resolves a real question not determined by the reported Betti groups. The five-collapse construction explains the geometry and provides a reusable exact certificate; this is a natural complete classification rather than an arbitrary or routine parameter increment.
